units.source_text: 千重子连脖颈都搽上了一层淡红粉。

en.t: Chieko had even brushed a layer of pale rouge powder onto the nape of her neck.

units.source_text: 这脖子又白又嫩，光滑润泽，富有青春的魅力，特别是上了淡红粉，实在美极了。

en.t: Her neck was white and tender, smooth and moist, full of youthful charm; with the pale rouge powder on it, it was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 她不时抚摸着脸颊，眼睛里闪露出娇媚的神态。

en.t: From time to time she stroked her cheeks, and a coquettish, charming look flickered in her eyes.
